en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene with ornate early‑20th‑century buildings, likely guesthouses or villas, along a gently sloping road lined with young trees and a fence. Overhead power and tram lines cross the view. In the foreground on the right there is a small kiosk or newsstand covered with posters and cards, with a person standing in front. The architecture features gabled roofs and decorative facades. The caption at the bottom left reads "Bad Elster Landfrauenheim."
